name: Tench
description: The tench is a peaceful bottom fish from the carp family. It is known for its olive-green coloration and its preference for weedy waters.
habitat: Tench prefer standing or slowly flowing waters with muddy bottoms and dense vegetation. They are often found in ponds, pools and weedy shore zones.
diet: Bottom feeder - feeds on insect larvae, snails, worms and plant material at the bottom of the water
features: Very small scales with thick mucus layer
Two short barbels on the mouth
conservation: Not endangered - stable populations in suitable waters
funFact: The tench is also called 'doctor fish'! In the past, people believed that its mucus had healing powers. In fact, the mucus layer contains antibacterial substances that protect it from infections.
